A replacement vehicle will be provided to the policyholder for a period of up to 12 days, provided that the insured vehicle is off the road due to covered damage and is located at a network garage. Reimbursement is calculated on the basis of the original receipt only; a photo of a receipt or a bank transfer confirmation does not constitute sufficient proof. doc: Section 4 – Water and Liquid Damage, Bayit Batuach Murhav Policy. The policy covers direct damage to the structure of the apartment and its contents caused by a sudden burst or leak of pipes, including pipes of an adjacent apartment. Where the source of the damage is in another apartment, the policyholder may file the claim with Hof Mivtachim Insurance, and the company will act to recover the amount from the responsible party or its insurer; the policyholder is under no obligation to first contact a third party's insurer. The deductible under this section is NIS 950 per damage event and is not calculated on an annual basis. Locating and repairing the source of the damage will be carried out by a plumber on behalf of the company, available 24 hours a day. If the policyholder hired a private professional without prior coordination, they will be reimbursed up to NIS 600 only for locating and repairing the damage, provided that a tax invoice and the professional's report are presented. Coverage does not include replacing pipes that have deteriorated due to age or rust, and does not include gradual damage caused by continuous dripping. A deposit paid to a contractor is not refunded in advance, but will be factored into the insurance benefits after the claim is approved by an assessor. The company will send an assessor to the apartment within 5 business days of the claim being opened. Damage must be reported within 14 days of its discovery; late reporting does not void coverage, but may reduce benefits if additional damage was caused by the delay. Where temporary evacuation of the apartment is required due to the damage, the company will pay alternative accommodation costs of up to NIS 400 per night and no more than 10 nights. Reimbursement for drying the apartment with dedicated equipment will be made only if the drying was carried out by a supplier approved in advance by the company.

doc: Cancellation at the Policyholder's Initiative – Ogen Family Policy. The cancellation will take effect 3 business days after the notice is received by the company, or on a later date specified by the policyholder. Premium paid for the month in which the cancellation takes effect will be refunded to the policyholder on a pro-rata basis, according to the number of days remaining in the month, within 14 days of the cancellation date. The Ogen Family policy is a pure risk policy, and therefore it has no surrender value and there is no refund of premiums paid in previous periods. Cancellation of the policy does not cancel coverage for an insured event that occurred before the cancellation took effect. A policyholder who cancelled the policy and wishes to renew it within 60 days may do so without new medical underwriting, provided that there has been no change in their health; after 60 days, rejoining under current terms will be required. The policyholder will receive written confirmation of cancellation within 7 days of the cancellation taking effect. A cancellation request made in a call that is not recorded as a formal declaration will not be considered a cancellation notice. If the policyholder holds an additional policy with the company, the cancellation will apply only to the policy specified in the notice and not to other policies. The pro-rata refund will be transferred to the payment method from which the last premium was collected.
